description: Source code for a utility wrapper around the Khronos glslang compiler, including shader source processing, resource management, and SPIR-V code generation for graphics shaders.

classes.name: IntermediateShaderSource
classes.description: Helper class for processing and transforming shader source code with macro markers.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes shader source by parsing macro markers.

methods.name: findTokenName
methods.description: Checks if a token with the given name exists.

methods.name: insertLayoutSpecifier
methods.description: Replaces @@ LAYOUT- macros with layout qualifiers.

methods.name: insertQualifierSpecifier
methods.description: Replaces @@ QUALIFIER- macros with qualifier strings.

methods.name: insertTransformFeedbackOutput
methods.description: Replaces @@ XFB-OUT macro with output code.

methods.name: getShaderSource
methods.description: Returns the processed shader source as a string.
